user.title: Connect to LikeHub
user.description: Enter your service account credentials. The password is used once to obtain tokens and is never stored.

site.title: Select site
site.description: Your account has several sites. Choose the one this Home Assistant installation serves.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authentication
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the password for {email}. Site settings will be preserved.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the server

init.title: LikeHub settings
init.description: Nothing leaves your home until you select entities. Remote control is disabled by default.

data.permit_open_water: Allow remote water opening (risk: water opens while you are away)

access_revoked.title: Access revoked
access_revoked.description: The service revoked access for this site. Re-authenticate in the integration settings.

site_blocked.title: Site blocked
site_blocked.description: The service blocked this site. Data sending has stopped. Contact support.

site_not_found.title: Site not found
site_not_found.description: The service does not know this site. It may have been deleted. Reinstall the integration.

roles_not_mapped.title: Roles not mapped
roles_not_mapped.description: Remote control is enabled but no role is mapped to an entity. Commands will be rejected.
